name: PO Price Check
script:
doc.custom_needs_expense_approval = 0 details = [] for item in doc.items: # Fetch the last purchase rate from the Item master (based on Stock UoM) base_last_rate = frappe.db.get_value("Item", item.item_code, "last_purchase_rate") or 0.0 # Get the conversion factor and calculate rates conversion_factor = item.conversion_factor or 1.0 adjusted_last_rate = base_last_rate * conversion_factor # Compare the current PO rate against the adjusted last rate if item.rate > adjusted_last_rate: doc.custom_needs_expense_approval = 1 # Format the base item information (rounding amounts to 2 decimal places) text_block = ( f"Item Code: {item.item_code}
" f"Description: {item.description or item.item_name}
" f"Quantity: {item.qty} {item.uom}
" f"Amount: {item.amount:,.2f}

" ) # Check if the PO UoM is different from the Stock UoM if item.uom != item.stock_uom and conversion_factor != 1.0: new_stock_rate = item.rate / conversion_factor if conversion_factor else item.rate text_block += ( f"Conversion: 1 {item.uom} = {conversion_factor} {item.stock_uom}

" f"PO UoM Pricing ({item.uom})
" f"• Last Rate: {adjusted_last_rate:,.2f}
" f"• New Rate: {item.rate:,.2f}

" f"Stock UoM Pricing ({item.stock_uom})
" f"• Last Rate: {base_last_rate:,.4f}
" f"• New Rate: {new_stock_rate:,.4f}
" ) else: # If UoM is the same, just print the rates once text_block += ( f"Last Rate ({item.uom}): {adjusted_last_rate:,.2f}
" f"New Rate ({item.uom}): {item.rate:,.2f}
" ) # Add a subtle dashed line to separate multiple items cleanly text_block += "

" details.append(text_block) # If approval is needed, format the details for the custom text field if doc.custom_needs_expense_approval: doc.custom_price_increase_details = "".join(details) else: doc.custom_price_increase_details = ""
